g.text: ⚔️ THE BEREGOST TIME LOOP — MASTER REGION MAP
INNER RED LOOP: Aerial Flight Limit (12:00 PM Cutoff)
Zephyr Gryphon / Fly (15m/hex). Beyond this, midday heat & thermals force mounts down.
OUTER RED LOOP: On-Foot Travel Limit (15:00 PM Cutoff)
Ground Foot (60m/hex) / Mount (30m/hex). Beyond this, 175°F surface conflagration is lethal.
